row.title: The coder job takes only issues its own organization wrote, and reads issue text fenced as data
row.body: RULE-OF-TWO-1 (ZHC-R12 #2677): executor.pick skips issues not by an owner, member, collaborator or the org's own bots; crossrepo reads REST issues so the author is known; issue text is wrapped in a random-marker data block.
